oil.summary: Crude sold off hard on Wednesday, with WTI dropping 4.64% to $82.03/bbl and Brent off 4.58% to $88.87, extending a brutal month that has erased roughly 19% from both benchmarks. The dominant driver is a supply-side reversal: despite ongoing Iranian tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz — with smaller vessels now absorbing the bulk of Hormuz traffic as supertankers are targeted — Middle East crude exports have broadly recovered, undermining the geopolitical risk premium. A U.S. EIA report showing a 3.4 million barrel build in domestic crude inventories for the week ending November 13 added further bearish weight. On the geopolitical front, the Trump administration announced a temporary easing of Russia oil sanctions to contain the price surge, drawing European pushback, while Trump simultaneously pressured Zelensky to halt strikes on Russian refineries and defended a reported Russia diesel deal facing bipartisan congressional criticism. Options markets now price a 77% probability of an OPEC cut at the May 2027 meeting.
drivers: Middle East crude exports recovering despite Hormuz tanker attacks, compressing the geopolitical risk premium
U.S. crude inventories rose 3.4 million barrels for the week ending November 13, adding bearish supply pressure
Trump administration temporarily eases Russia oil sanctions and pushes to curb Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy infrastructure, increasing expected Russian supply
sources: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos

gas.summary: Natural gas markets diverged sharply today: Henry Hub surged 6.42% to $3.414/MMBtu, its strongest single-day gain in months and up 15% over the past month, while European TTF slumped 5.03% to €81.105/MWh. The U.S. rally likely reflects tightening domestic balances and LNG export demand — China Gas Holdings doubled its contracted volumes from U.S. exporter Venture Global, signalling robust Asian pull on American cargoes. On the supply side, Mozambique's government approved ExxonMobil's revised $30 billion Rovuma LNG development plan, a long-dated positive for global LNG supply. Meanwhile, the Iran conflict continues to cast a shadow: a headline warns that UK household energy bills are set to jump 26% from January 2027 to a four-year high, partly attributable to the ongoing Iran war inflating wholesale gas prices.
drivers: China Gas Holdings doubles LNG offtake from U.S. Venture Global, tightening American LNG export capacity and supporting Henry Hub
Iran war cited as pushing UK 2027 household energy bills to their highest since 2023, underpinning geopolitical risk premium in European gas
Mozambique approves ExxonMobil's $30 billion Rovuma LNG plan, adding long-dated global supply; TTF retreats on broader supply recovery signals

power.summary: EU carbon allowances (EUA) suffered their steepest single-session decline in recent weeks, falling 8.28% to $76.25/EUA and extending a 10.74% weekly loss. The sell-off tracked the sharp drop in TTF gas prices (-5.03% on the day), which reduces the cost of gas-fired generation and lowers the implied carbon cost needed to incentivise fuel switching. Broader macro risk-off sentiment tied to energy market volatility may also be weighing on EUA demand. On the structural side, the ongoing Iran war is flagged as pushing UK 2027 wholesale energy costs sharply higher, and EU authorities are tightening sanctions on Russian banks and energy firms. News flow for EU power-specific assets is relatively thin today beyond these macro cross-currents; the Thames Water restructuring story adds colour to stressed European utility sector conditions but has limited direct EUA pricing relevance.
drivers: Sharp TTF gas decline reduces fuel-switching incentive, mechanically pressuring EUA prices lower in tandem
EU tightens sanctions on Russian energy firms and banks, adding long-term supply uncertainty but offering no near-term price support for carbon
Iran conflict expected to lift UK wholesale energy bills 26% from January 2027, highlighting persistent geopolitical risk premium in European power markets
sources: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
